segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func storeCloudRecord(_ record: CKRecord, on product: Product) { // Encode the record's metadata. let coder = NSKeyedArchiver(requiringSecureCoding: true) record.encodeSystemFields(with: coder) // Attach the encoded metadata to the // model object so you can store it in // your local cache. product.recordMetadata = coder.encodedData } func extractCloudRecord(from product: Product) throws -> CKRecord? { guard let metadata = product.recordMetadata else { return nil } // Create an unarchiver from the record's stored metadata // and use it to create an instance of CKRecord. let coder = try NSKeyedUnarchiver(forReadingFrom: metadata) let record = CKRecord(coder: coder) coder.finishDecoding() // Return the record to the caller, which can update its // fields using the product's properties before saving // it to iCloud. return record } ```
